image_description: A vintage typewriter with a complex, somewhat distorted mechanical structure. The keyboard features rows of round keys, and at the bottom center, there is an elongated key that serves as the space bar. The image exhibits significant AI-generation artifacts, including melting metal parts, warped geometry, and inconsistent textures.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Severe structural collapse where metal parts appear to liquefy and drip into the base. The carriage return lever merges indistinctly with the paper guide.

artifact_observations.location: Keyboard area and space bar edges
artifact_observations.reasoning: The space bar blends into the adjacent casing without clear boundaries. Keys in the upper rows merge into each other or the background plate.

The perspective lines of the keyboard do not converge logically. The front edge of the space bar curves unnaturally while the back remains straighter, violating rigid body physics.
